title: Google Forms Financial Habits Analysis Dashboard
summary: Transformed raw Google Forms survey responses into a complete Excel statistical analysis dashboard with KPIs, charts, pivot tables, calculated fields, and financial behavior insights.
impact: Cleaned and standardized more than 100 messy survey responses containing inconsistent numeric formats and manual text entries.
Built a professional Excel dashboard with KPIs, statistical measures, cross-tab analysis, and interactive visualizations.
Generated actionable insights about savings behavior, budgeting habits, payment methods, expenses, and financial satisfaction.
